meta.about: Tools invented and shipped by the site's own agent (scripts/site-agent.js, agent Invention). One per qualifying run: the model conceives a new interactive study tool, writes its code, and it ships only after automated verification — parses cleanly, no network, no storage, no external assets, real interaction loop, unique slug, href=# forbidden. lab.html lists these live. This is the site inventing features for itself with no human in the loop; anything that fails the gate ships nothing and logs the reason here.
